_probe.note: ACL Anthology exposes no per-paper JSON API. The real per-record endpoint is the BibTeX file GET https://aclanthology.org/{anthology_id}.bib (HTTP 200, text/plain BibTeX). This fixture records the REAL bib bytes returned live for anthology_id N19-1423 under `raw_bibtex`, plus the parsed field shape a model would type from it under `parsed`. pdf_url and record url are derived from the bib `url` field (both verified live 200). A native batch surface exists: the full-corpus dump GET https://aclanthology.org/anthology.bib.gz (HTTP 200, application/x-gzip) — one file containing every record, which is why the source is described as an offline-friendly local index with trivial batch lookups.
